text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the trainer's 
office, Matikanetannhauser was pressed 
against the wall, flailing her arms.
choice_data_list: What... are you doing?
What... are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...She had turned into a spider.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's not it! It's not like anything 
strange happened or anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There's a perfectly good reason for this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Thanksgiving Festival is 
over, why don't we have an after-party 
combined with cherry blossom viewing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! I can't wait for flower 
viewing~! I wanna bring a multi-tiered 
bento box and stuff~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's nice and all, but when it comes to 
cherry blossom viewing... you gotta have a 
talent show!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—And so, for my party trick, I'm thinking 
of doing an impression of a spider!
choice_data_list: Why a spider...?
Why a spider...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I think it'll catch everyone completely 
off guard! After all, it's well-known that 
I'm scared of spiders!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it's pretty hard to check if I'm 
doing it right all by myself~..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! If you have time, would you mind 
watching my practice~?!
choice_data_list:
I don't mind if it's only that much, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~! Let's get started 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun!
choice_data_list: What... what kind of training is that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm practicing how to be a 
spider!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Spiders spread their legs to look bigger, 
right? I'm recreating that...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to practice hanging from high 
places, bungee jumping is the only way to 
go!"
choice_data_list: Aren't you being a bit too decisive?!
Aren't you being a bit too decisive?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here I go~! Hup! Hupâ

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Since I can't shoot thread and spin a web, 
I thought I'd make a website instead!
choice_data_list: How did it end up like this...
How does it end up like that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
'Web' means spider web, after all, so I 
thought it'd be the perfect substitute!!

And so, the days of various spider 
training continued. Just what was driving 
her so far...? Today too, she was 
practicing poses in front of the mirror, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"It's no gooood...! It's not scary at 
aaaaall..."
choice_data_list: You don't have to be so down about it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, because I'm sure everyone else is 
going to bring an amazing gag...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nature said she's got tons of masters for 
quick comedy bits before! And Turbo's a 
genius at making people laugh with pure 
energy...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whatever Ikuno does is top quality, and 
above all, the gap with her poker face 
will make it a guaranteed smash hit...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
With a half-baked performance like that, 
we don't stand a chance. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I feel so bad for Nature and the others 
who are giving it their all! I have to get 
better!"
choice_data_list:
So you want to aim for perfection... Got 
it!

You want to aim for perfection, huh...? 
Got it!

text_block_list.text:
If she's being serious about this, then I 
should take it seriously too and join her 
spider practice!

How much time had passed since then? Just 
as she struck her spider pose in front of 
the mirror for the umpteenth time—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun! How about this time——

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eep, eeeeek~~~~!?
choice_data_list: Are you okay?!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-E-Eek, scary! The way I skittered just 
now made me look like a spider—
choice_data_list: Which means...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― I did it... I did it!! I became the 
perfect spider~!

And so came the day of the Thanksgiving 
after-party and cherry blossom viewing. 
The party trick contest began.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun! Shuuu...! *snap*, *crack*, *pop*...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha~!! Nice, nice~!! Machitan, you 
look so spider-y~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, especially how accurately it 
recreates the sound of pedipalps rubbing 
together—it gives me goosebumps...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! They look similar, sure, but that's 
just way too surreal~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Yay~! A huge success~~~!!

Matikanetannhauser pulled off a 
delightfully satisfying party trick and 
successfully hyped up the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-E-Eek, scary! The way I skittered just 
now made me look like a spider—
choice_data_list: Which means...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― I did it... I did it!! I became the 
perfect spider~!

And so came the day of the Thanksgiving 
after-party and cherry blossom viewing. 
The party trick contest began.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun! Shuuu...! *snap*, *crack*——
(Drip, drip...)

Just then... a tiny spider descended 
smoothly from a cherry blossom branch 
right before Matikanetannhauser's eyes...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pakyaaahhhhh~?! SPIDERRRRRRRRRRRRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaaaaa!! Machitan, your face is 
hilarious~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was indeed a truly entertaining 
funny face!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Wait, could this actually be for real...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*sob*~~... It wasn't supposed to be like 
this~~...!

The crowd was hyped, but things didn't go 
quite as Matikanetannhauser had hoped.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-E-Eek, so creepy! Moving like a spider 
just now surprised even me...!
choice_data_list: You can be way more spider-like than that!
You can be way more like a spider!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! You're right! Since we're doing 
this, let's get even more into character 
as spiders!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To get close to Mr. Spider... you have to 
become one yourself, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(I'm a spider! I'm a spider! I'm a spider, 
I'm a spider...)

It's not much different from her previous 
pose, but it's taken on an intimidating 
presence... It feels like being stared at 
by a giant spider. Could this be—
choice_data_list: It looks even more like a spider now!
It looks even more like a spider now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!! With this, I can totally surprise 
everyone at the party trick contest~!

Afterward, she masterfully demonstrated 
her spider impression at the after-party, 
succeeding in bringing roaring life to the 
whole gathering.
